enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in on the public holiday
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Stretch arms. Turn to back. Snore. Shift legs. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to left side. Breathe deeply. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up slowly, checking phone and messages in bed
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Blink. Stretch arms. Yawn. Turn head to side. Reach for phone on bedside table. Pick up phone. Press power button. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Scroll through messages. Read messages. Tap on message. Type reply. Send reply. Put phone down on bed. Rub eyes. Sit up in bed. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting dressed for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light and shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Apply soap and wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out and pick up towel. Dry body. Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Pick out clothes and put on clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with toast and tea using the toaster and kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open fridge and take out bread, butter, and milk. Close fridge. Open cupboard and take out plate and mug. Open toaster and insert bread. Press lever. Fill kettle with water and turn on. Remove toast from toaster. Butter toast. Pour hot water into mug. Add tea bag and stir. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Finish eating. Clear table. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing on the couch
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Press power button. Change channel. Adjust volume. Lean back. Cross legs. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Change channel again. Stretch arms. Yawn. Continue watching.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying business coursework and reviewing lecture notes on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for startup. Log in. Open browser. Navigate to university portal. Open lecture notes. Read notes. Highlight text. Open word processor. Type notes. Scroll through notes. Take a break. Stretch. Continue reading. Type more notes. Save document. Close laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a hot lunch with the induction cooker and rice cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open fridge and take out vegetables and meat. Close fridge. Open cupboard and take out rice. Measure and wash rice. Put rice in rice cooker with water. Turn on rice cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan and add oil. Add vegetables and meat. Stir. Add sauce. Cover pan. Wait. Turn off induction cooker. Turn off rice cooker. Serve lunch on plate. Sit at table.
Sit at table. Pick up chopsticks. Pick up bowl. Scoop rice. Bring to mouth. Chew. Swallow. Pick up vegetables. Eat. Sip water. Continue eating. Finish meal. Stand up. Clear table. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing laundry with the washing machine and tidying up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open washing machine. Sort clothes. Load clothes into machine. Add detergent. Close lid. Press start button. Walk to bedroom. Pick up items from floor. Fold clothes. Put clothes in wardrobe. Wipe surfaces. Sweep floor. Return to bathroom. Check washing machine. Wait. Remove clothes. Hang clothes to dry. Fold dry clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking to the shops for groceries and browsing retail stores
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Open door and walk out. Close door. Walk to shops. Enter grocery store. Pick up basket. Walk through aisles and pick up vegetables, meat, bread, milk, and snacks. Go to checkout. Pay for groceries. Bag groceries. Exit store. Walk to retail store. Browse clothing. Try on shirt. Exit store. Walk home. Open door. Enter house. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Unpacking groceries and preparing a snack
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Put bags on counter. Unpack groceries. Put vegetables in fridge. Put meat in fridge. Put milk in fridge. Put bread in cupboard. Put snacks in cupboard. Close fridge. Open cupboard. Take out peanut butter. Take out bread. Open bread bag. Take out slice. Spread peanut butter. Put bread in toaster. Press lever. Wait. Remove toast. Eat snack.

enriched_activities.activity: Playing video games on the game console
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up controller. Turn on console. Select game. Press start. Move controller. Press buttons. Play game. Pause game. Check phone. Resume game. Continue playing. Finish game. Turn off console. Put controller down.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner using the oven and induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open fridge and take out ingredients. Close fridge. Open cupboard and take out pots and pans. Turn on oven and preheat. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan and add oil. Add ingredients and stir. Place dish in oven. Set timer. Wait. Check oven. Remove dish. Turn off oven and induction cooker. Serve dinner on plate. Sit at table.
Sit at table. Pick up utensils. Cut food. Bring to mouth. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Continue eating. Finish meal. Stand up. Clear table. Wash dishes. Dry dishes. Put dishes away. Wipe table.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on university assignments on the computer with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Press power button. Log in. Open assignment file. Read instructions. Type content. Scroll. Edit text. Save document. Take a break. Stretch. Resume typing. Check references. Type more. Save document. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching a show on TV and scrolling on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Lean back. Pick up phone. Open social media. Scroll. Like post. Comment. Put phone down. Watch TV. Pick up phone again. Scroll. Put phone down. Turn off TV.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up face wash. Apply to face. Wash face. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading on the phone and winding down before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Pick up phone. Open reading app. Read. Scroll. Turn page. Read more. Put phone down. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Fall asleep.
